shared.name: Showboat
shared.definition: Players with this trait will be able to use Celebration Loco on breakaways.

shared.name: Cannonball
shared.definition: Players with this trait will be able to do Celebration Dives into the endzone.

shared.name: Steering Clear
shared.definition: Players with this trait will attempt to avoid hits by performing slides, give-ups, or running out of bounds.

shared.name: Run Over
shared.definition: Players with this trait will have a higher tendency to attempt a truck, and if they are a QB, they are less likely to slide.

shared.name: Stiff Arm Tendency
shared.definition: Players with this trait will have a higher tendency to attempt a stiff arm, and if they are a QB, they are less likely to slide.

shared.name: Whirlwind
shared.definition: Players with this trait will have a higher tendency to attempt a spin move.

shared.name: Elusive Instinct
shared.definition: Players with this trait will have a higher tendency to attempt a juke move.

shared.name: Cover Ball
shared.definition: Players with this trait will attempt to cover the ball on all big hits.

shared.name: Undisciplined
shared.definition: Players with this trait will have a higher tendency to commit penalties.

shared.name: Disciplined
shared.definition: Players with this trait will have a lower tendency to commit penalties.

QB.name: Look For Stars
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will look to throw to their star receivers more.

QB.name: Risk Taker
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will tend to force the ball downfield and throw it into tight windows.

QB.name: Conservative
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will tend to throw shorter passes and avoid forcing passes into tight windows.

QB.name: Cannon
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will have a higher tendency to throw bullet passes.

QB.name: Up And Over
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will have a higher tendency to throw lob passes.

QB.name: Snap Mischief
QB.definition: QBs with this trait often perform fake hikes, especially on late downs in short-yardage situations.

QB.name: Seeing Ghosts
QB.definition: After a sack, QBs with this trait will tend to force a pass to their first read for the next three plays, resetting at the end of a drive.

QB.name: Quick Trigger
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will quickly attempt throws to their check down, not waiting for the play to develop.

QB.name: Throw Away
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will have a higher tendency to throw the ball away when facing pressure.

QB.name: Panic Button
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will have a higher tendency to force passes when facing pressure.
QBs with this trait will have a higher tendency to force passes in the 4th quarter.

QB.name: Double Back
QB.definition: QBs with this trait can scramble away from the sideline to keep the play alive.

QB.name: Eyes Up
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will keep their eyes up when moving towards the LOS, waiting longer for plays to develop before scrambling.

QB.name: Hero Ball
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will attempt to scramble for yards if they think they can get the first down.

QB.name: Quick Clock
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will tend to escape the pocket after making their first read.

QB.name: Happy Feet
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will almost always be moving in the pocket.

QB.name: Paranoid
QB.definition: QBs with this trait react more to nearby defenders, feeling pressured even in less intense situations.

QB.name: Oblivious
QB.definition: QBs with this trait remain calm near defenders, feeling less pressure even in intense situations.

QB.name: Throw It Up
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will have a higher tendency to target outside receivers on deep or contested throws.

QB.name: Anchored
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will have a lower tendency to leave the pocket or scramble for yards.

QB.name: Fortifier
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will have a higher tendency to audible into Max Protection against potential pressure.

QB.name: Traveling Showmen
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will tend to throw deeper passes and force passes when the stadium pulse is high.

QB.name: Frozen Solid
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will tend to play more conservatively when cold.

QB.name: Snow Ball
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will tend to play more aggressively when cold.

QB.name: Invincible
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will tend to play more aggressively when hot.

QB.name: Free Play Finder
QB.definition: QBs with this trait will identify when they have a free play and attempt riskier throws.

MIKE.name: Big Hitter
MIKE.definition: Players with this trait will have a higher tendency to attempt Hit Sticks.

MIKE.name: Safe Tackler
MIKE.definition: Players with this trait will have a higher tendency to attempt Conservative tackles.

MIKE.name: Punch It Out
MIKE.definition: Players with this trait will have a higher tendency to attempt Strip tackles.

MIKE.name: Undercut
MIKE.definition: Players with this trait will have a higher tendency to attempt Cut Sticks.

MIKE.name: Nose Dive
MIKE.definition: Players with this trait will focus on the dive or run option for both Option plays and RPOs and the pitch option for pitch plays.
